# verda locations

List available datacenter locations

List all available Verda Cloud datacenter locations.

**Usage**

```text
verda locations [flags]
```

Aliases: `location`, `loc`

**Examples**

```bash
verda locations
verda locations -o json
```

---

Global flags such as `--output`, `--agent` and `--debug` work with every command: see [Global Flags](../commands.md#global-flags).
